issues.detail: F1 needs exact manufacturer part and verified pinout.

releaseStatus: TRAINING ONLY — NEVER A FABRICATION SIGNOFF

steps.title: Schematic & supplier validation
steps.details: Verify connector polarity, pin mapping, reference designators, ratings and manufacturer part numbers.

steps.title: Routing & geometry
steps.details: Run training geometry checks; then check every rule with native KiCad DRC/ERC and real library models.

steps.title: Stackup & impedances
steps.details: Approve layer count, dielectric geometry, copper weight, controlled-impedance coupons and tolerances with the fabricator.

steps.title: Artwork generation
steps.details: Produce manufacturer-approved native CAD Gerber/ODB++/IPC-2581 and Excellon NC drill files.

steps.title: Drill, plating & lamination
steps.details: Confirm plated/non-plated holes, annular rings, aspect ratio, finish, solder mask and via processing.

steps.title: Assembly documentation
steps.details: Verify component polarity, centroid rotation, footprints, substitutions, stencil and reflow plan.

steps.title: Inspection & test
steps.details: Inspect solder joints and assembly orientation; run continuity, shorts, programming and functional tests.

steps.title: Release gate
steps.details: Sign off DFM/DFT, electrical test, BOM procurement and revision control before manufacturing.
